final: WITH g AS (SELECT link_to_major, COUNT(*) AS c FROM member GROUP BY link_to_major), s AS (SELECT c, c*1.0/(SELECT SUM(c) FROM g) AS sh FROM g), a AS (SELECT AVG(sh) AS av FROM s) SELECT SUM(c) AS total_members, AVG(sh) AS avg_share, AVG(sh - av) AS avg_excess_over_avg_share FROM s, a WHERE sh > av
